dialogues.jp: 「やばい！　遅れた」
dialogues.en: "Gah, I'm going to be late!"
dialogues.text: "Gah, I'm going to be late!"

dialogues.jp: 俺はかつて無いほどダッシュしている。
dialogues.en: I was running as fast as I could.
dialogues.text: I was running as fast as I could.

dialogues.jp: 今日から、新学期、それも本校入学第一日目だ！
dialogues.en:
Today's the first day of the new school year, I can't afford
to be late!
dialogues.text:
Today's the first day of the new school year, I can't afford
to be late!

dialogues.jp:
今日こそは、早く起きなければ、と固く決意を
していたのに。
dialogues.en:
I was hoping to wake up early today, but a certain girl did
me in.
dialogues.text:
I was hoping to wake up early today, but a certain girl did
me in.

dialogues.jp: 頭の中に、昨日の環の言葉が浮かぶ。
dialogues.en: Her words from yesterday kept spinning through my mind.
dialogues.text: Her words from yesterday kept spinning through my mind.

dialogues.jp:
『これからは一緒に学校へ行こう』と約束した
のに……。
dialogues.en: "Let's walk to school together". We promised that...
dialogues.text: "Let's walk to school together". We promised that...

dialogues.jp:
まったく、初日からこんなんじゃ、先が思いや
られるな。
dialogues.en:
Damn, if only I knew the first day of school would be this
stressful.
dialogues.text:
Damn, if only I knew the first day of school would be this
stressful.

dialogues.jp: ああ。環、待ってるだろうな……。
dialogues.en: Ahhh, Tamaki's waiting for me...
dialogues.text: Ahhh, Tamaki's waiting for me...

dialogues.jp: 俺は、やっとの思いで桜公園にたどり着く。
dialogues.en: I finally reached the Sakura Park, panting.
dialogues.text: I finally reached the Sakura Park, panting.

dialogues.jp: 思ったとおり、制服姿の環が立っていた。
dialogues.en:
Just as I had predicted, Tamaki was already there, clad in
the new school uniform.
dialogues.text:
Just as I had predicted, Tamaki was already there, clad in
the new school uniform.

dialogues.jp: 「すまん！」
dialogues.en: "Sorry!"
dialogues.text: "Sorry!"

dialogues.jp: 息を切らし、俺は急いで環に駆け寄る。
dialogues.en: I hurried over to her, panting heavily.
dialogues.text: I hurried over to her, panting heavily.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「おはようございます。朝倉様」
dialogues.en: "Good morning, Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "Good morning, Asakura-sama."

dialogues.jp:
環は、俺が遅れたことを気にしていないのか、
笑顔で挨拶をしてくれる。
dialogues.en:
Seemingly not even noticing my tardiness, she greeted me
with a smile.
dialogues.text:
Seemingly not even noticing my tardiness, she greeted me
with a smile.

dialogues.jp: 「ごめんな。遅れて」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, I'm kinda late."
dialogues.text: "Sorry, I'm kinda late."

dialogues.jp:
起きて急な運動をしたせいか、声が｛かす／掠｝れてしま
う。
dialogues.en: My voice was barely audible over my constant breaths.
dialogues.text: My voice was barely audible over my constant breaths.

dialogues.jp:
環の制服は、付属のものから、本校制服に替わっ
ていた。悪くない。
dialogues.en:
She was wearing the new school uniform of the main school...
it looks good on her.
dialogues.text:
She was wearing the new school uniform of the main school...
it looks good on her.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ひょっとして、走ってきてくれたんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Did you, perhaps, run all the way here?"
dialogues.text: "Did you, perhaps, run all the way here?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「わたくしも今来たところですから……。そん
　なに急がなくても大丈夫ですよ」
dialogues.en:
"I had only just arrived... there was no need to be in such
a rush."
dialogues.text:
"I had only just arrived... there was no need to be in such
a rush."

dialogues.jp: 環はクスリと笑って、俺に言う。
dialogues.en: She giggled at my baffled expression.
dialogues.text: She giggled at my baffled expression.

dialogues.jp: 「そ、そうか」
dialogues.en: "A, ahh..."
dialogues.text: "A, ahh..."

dialogues.jp: そう言ってもらうと救われる。
dialogues.en: Those were just conforting words, I'm sure.
dialogues.text: Those were just conforting words, I'm sure.

dialogues.jp:
もちろん、環のことだから、もっと前から待っ
ていたに違いない。
dialogues.en:
Knowing her, it's likely that she was waiting there longer
than she let on.
dialogues.text:
Knowing her, it's likely that she was waiting there longer
than she let on.

dialogues.jp:
でも、『今、来たところ』と言って、俺に気を
使わないように、環がしてくれているのが、よ
くわかる。
dialogues.en:
She's exactly the type to brush off inconveniences like that
with reassuring words.
dialogues.text:
She's exactly the type to brush off inconveniences like that
with reassuring words.

dialogues.jp: やっぱり、環って優しいよな……。
dialogues.en: She's really too kind...
dialogues.text: She's really too kind...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、行きましょうか？」
dialogues.en: "Shall we go?"
dialogues.text: "Shall we go?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「おう」
dialogues.en: "Sure."
dialogues.text: "Sure."

dialogues.jp: 俺と環は、並んで歩き出した。
dialogues.en: We headed off, side by side.
dialogues.text: We headed off, side by side.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いよいよ、入学式ですね」
dialogues.en: "We'd have the school entrance ceremony first..."
dialogues.text: "We'd have the school entrance ceremony first..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "Mmm."
dialogues.text: "Mmm."

dialogues.jp:
と、言っても、正直、校舎が隣に移るだけでワ
クワクするような気持ちも無い。
dialogues.en:
To be frank, going to a new school wasn't nearly as exciting
as it should be, as it's practically right next door.
dialogues.text:
To be frank, going to a new school wasn't nearly as exciting
as it should be, as it's practically right next door.

dialogues.jp:
女の子は制服が替わるからいいものの、男は付
属となんらかわりがないから、気持ちの切り替
えもしにくいというものだ。
dialogues.en:
And while the girls get a change of uniform, the guys get to
wear the same ones in the main school.
dialogues.text:
And while the girls get a change of uniform, the guys get to
wear the same ones in the main school.

dialogues.jp:
なので、俺にとっては、休み明けの新学期とあ
まり変わらない。
dialogues.en:
It's hard to tell that I just woke up into a new school
year.
dialogues.text:
It's hard to tell that I just woke up into a new school
year.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「せっかく、今のクラスに慣れてきたと思った
　のに」
dialogues.en: "And I'd only just gotten used to my class, too..."
dialogues.text: "And I'd only just gotten used to my class, too..."

dialogues.jp:
環にとっては、今度のクラスも転校してきた時
と同じような緊張感があるのだろう。
dialogues.en: Tamaki seemed as nervous as the day she transferred here.
dialogues.text: Tamaki seemed as nervous as the day she transferred here.

dialogues.jp: 「そうだな……」
dialogues.en: "Yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah..."

dialogues.jp: 同じクラスだったしな……。
dialogues.en: We were in the same class before, too...
dialogues.text: We were in the same class before, too...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「うまく馴染めるといいけど……」
dialogues.en: "It would be good to adapt to many situations, but..."
dialogues.text: "It would be good to adapt to many situations, but..."

dialogues.jp:
新しい環境に対する不安は、きっといつでもつ
きまとうものなんだろう。
dialogues.en:
No matter when, where or how, a new environment would always
bring uncertainty and uneasiness.
dialogues.text:
No matter when, where or how, a new environment would always
bring uncertainty and uneasiness.

dialogues.jp:
俺が側にいて、そんな不安も消してやれたらい
いんだけど……。
dialogues.en:
If I was with her, I could maybe help some of those worries
go away...
dialogues.text:
If I was with her, I could maybe help some of those worries
go away...

dialogues.jp: 「……同じクラスに」
dialogues.en: ".......The same class..."
dialogues.text: ".......The same class..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は照れ隠しに、コホンと一つ、咳払いをする。
dialogues.en: I embarassedly coughed, repeating myself.
dialogues.text: I embarassedly coughed, repeating myself.

dialogues.jp: 「同じクラスになれるといいな」
dialogues.en: "I hope we're in the same class."
dialogues.text: "I hope we're in the same class."

dialogues.jp: 俺の言葉に、環は赤面して頷く。
dialogues.en: Tamaki reddened upon hearing my words, nodding silently.
dialogues.text: Tamaki reddened upon hearing my words, nodding silently.

dialogues.jp: その姿に、言った俺まで赤面する。
dialogues.en:
If she keeps behaving like that, I'm going to start blushing
too...
dialogues.text:
If she keeps behaving like that, I'm going to start blushing
too...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「わたくしも……」

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……今、わたくしも言おうと思ってました」
dialogues.en: "...You took the words right from my mind."
dialogues.text: "...You took the words right from my mind."

dialogues.jp: 何だか、照れくさい。
dialogues.en: This is rather... awkward.
dialogues.text: This is rather... awkward.

dialogues.jp:
自分の気持ちを素直に言うのって、勇気がいる
ことだよな。
dialogues.en:
It really takes a lot of courage to honestly say your
feelings.
dialogues.text:
It really takes a lot of courage to honestly say your
feelings.

dialogues.jp:
新しい生活の始まる学校へ、俺達は入っていっ
た。
dialogues.en:
We eventually entered the school, on the start of another
chapter of our lives.
dialogues.text:
We eventually entered the school, on the start of another
chapter of our lives.

dialogues.jp:
俺と環は、掲示板に張ってあるクラス編成を見
るために、中庭に向かう。
dialogues.en:
Our first interest was, understandably, the class rosters.
We immediately went to the courtyard bulletin board.
dialogues.text:
Our first interest was, understandably, the class rosters.
We immediately went to the courtyard bulletin board.

dialogues.jp: すると、掲示板にはもう人だかりができていた。
dialogues.en: Unsurprisingly, a lot of people had the same idea as us.
dialogues.text: Unsurprisingly, a lot of people had the same idea as us.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、あそこだ」
dialogues.en: "Ah, there it is."
dialogues.text: "Ah, there it is."

dialogues.jp:
俺達が側に近づくと、何人かの学生がこちらを
見る。
dialogues.en: As we got closer, I had a sudden feeling of being watched.
dialogues.text: As we got closer, I had a sudden feeling of being watched.

dialogues.jp: あれ？　いつもと何だか違う。
dialogues.en: Hm...? This is unusual...
dialogues.text: Hm...? This is unusual...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様？　どうかしたんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama? Is something the matter?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama? Is something the matter?"

dialogues.jp: 心配そうに環が尋ねる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki asked me, slightly worried.
dialogues.text: Tamaki asked me, slightly worried.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、いや……。さて、探すか」
dialogues.en: "Ah, no... let's search for our names."
dialogues.text: "Ah, no... let's search for our names."

dialogues.jp: まあ、気のせいだろ。
dialogues.en: It must just be my imagination.
dialogues.text: It must just be my imagination.

dialogues.jp: 俺は掲示板に目を移す。
dialogues.en: My eyes travelled quickly over the bulletin board.
dialogues.text: My eyes travelled quickly over the bulletin board.

dialogues.jp:
中には、見たことのある名前や、全く知らない
名前もある。
dialogues.en:
There were tons of names on it, both familiar and
unfamiliar.
dialogues.text:
There were tons of names on it, both familiar and
unfamiliar.

dialogues.jp: １組から、環と一緒に二人の名前を探す。
dialogues.en:
We started from Class 1, working through the list to find
our names.
dialogues.text:
We started from Class 1, working through the list to find
our names.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、あった」
dialogues.en: "Ah, there it is!"
dialogues.text: "Ah, there it is!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、本当だ」
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.jp: １組の名前の中に、環を見つける。
dialogues.en: Tamaki looked towards my eye's gaze.
dialogues.text: Tamaki looked towards my eye's gaze.

dialogues.jp: 「環は１組だな」
dialogues.en: "You're in Class 1."
dialogues.text: "You're in Class 1."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい。でも、朝倉様の名前はないですね」
dialogues.en: "Yes. But your name isn't there..."
dialogues.text: "Yes. But your name isn't there..."

dialogues.jp: がっかりした声で、環が言う。
dialogues.en: Her voice had a tinge of dejection.
dialogues.text: Her voice had a tinge of dejection.

dialogues.jp: 「そうだな。クラス、離れちゃったな」
dialogues.en: "You're right... guess we'd be seperated."
dialogues.text: "You're right... guess we'd be seperated."

dialogues.jp: じゃあ、俺は何組なんだろう？
dialogues.en: Which class am I in, then?
dialogues.text: Which class am I in, then?

dialogues.jp: ２組以降を順番に追っていく。
dialogues.en: I started searching again, from Class 2 onwards.
dialogues.text: I started searching again, from Class 2 onwards.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉様の名前、ありましたよ」
dialogues.en: "Ah, I've found your name."
dialogues.text: "Ah, I've found your name."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「お？　どれどれ」
dialogues.en: "Oh? Show me."
dialogues.text: "Oh? Show me."

dialogues.jp: 環の指差す方を見ると、３組に俺の名前がある。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki's finger pointed towards the list of names under
Class 3.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki's finger pointed towards the list of names under
Class 3.

dialogues.jp: その横に、見慣れた名前を見つける。
dialogues.en: There were two familiar names sandwiching mine on the list.
dialogues.text: There were two familiar names sandwiching mine on the list.

dialogues.jp: 杉並とことりも同じクラスか。
dialogues.en: I'd be in the same class as Suginami and Kotori...
dialogues.text: I'd be in the same class as Suginami and Kotori...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ああ。離れてしまいましたね」
dialogues.en: "Ahh... we aren't in the same class."
dialogues.text: "Ahh... we aren't in the same class."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「本当だな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp: そっか、残念。
dialogues.en: That's disappointing.
dialogues.text: That's disappointing.

dialogues.jp:
同じクラスになれば、環が馴染めなくても、何
とかしてあげられるんだけどな。
dialogues.en:
It'd be hard for Tamaki, being in a new class with no one
she's close to.
dialogues.text:
It'd be hard for Tamaki, being in a new class with no one
she's close to.

dialogues.jp: それに、毎日でも一緒に会えるのに……。
dialogues.en: And we could've been seeing each other a lot more often...
dialogues.text: And we could've been seeing each other a lot more often...

dialogues.jp:
まあ、同じクラスじゃなくても、毎日会えるよ
うに、朝、頑張って早く起きよう。
dialogues.en:
Well, since we're not in the same class, I'd have to work on
getting up earlier every day.
dialogues.text:
Well, since we're not in the same class, I'd have to work on
getting up earlier every day.

dialogues.jp: と、新たに誓いを立てる。
dialogues.en: I made that vow to myself.
dialogues.text: I made that vow to myself.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun!"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun!"

dialogues.jp:
ふと振り返ると、ことりが俺と環の後ろに立っ
ている。
dialogues.en:
I turned around instinctively. Kotori was standing behind
Tamaki and myself.
dialogues.text:
I turned around instinctively. Kotori was standing behind
Tamaki and myself.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「同じクラスみたいね。よろしくね」
dialogues.en: "I guess we're in the same class. Let's work hard!"
dialogues.text: "I guess we're in the same class. Let's work hard!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「おう、よろしくな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, let's."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, let's."

dialogues.jp: 同じクラスに知っているヤツがいるのは心強い。
dialogues.en: It's heartening to have people you know in a new class.
dialogues.text: It's heartening to have people you know in a new class.

dialogues.jp: 環のクラスにも、誰かいるといいんだけど……。
dialogues.en:
As long as there's someone Tamaki knows in hers, I'd be okay
with it...
dialogues.text:
As long as there's someone Tamaki knows in hers, I'd be okay
with it...

dialogues.jp: ことりは、俺の隣の環を見て、
dialogues.en: Kotori then switched her view to Tamaki, beside me.
dialogues.text: Kotori then switched her view to Tamaki, beside me.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「胡ノ宮さん、この間は、本当にありがとう」
dialogues.en: "And Konomiya-san, thank you so much for that time."
dialogues.text: "And Konomiya-san, thank you so much for that time."

dialogues.jp: と軽くお辞儀をする。
dialogues.en: Kotori bowed deeply in front of Tamaki.
dialogues.text: Kotori bowed deeply in front of Tamaki.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「この間？」
dialogues.en: "That time?"
dialogues.text: "That time?"

dialogues.jp: 環は不思議そうにことりに尋ねる。
dialogues.en: Confused, Tamaki directly asked Kotori.
dialogues.text: Confused, Tamaki directly asked Kotori.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、卒業パーティーで助けてもらって」
dialogues.en: "You know, at the graduation party! You saved me then."
dialogues.text: "You know, at the graduation party! You saved me then."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ああ、そうでしたね」
dialogues.en: "A, ahhh, that time."
dialogues.text: "A, ahhh, that time."

dialogues.jp:
環は照れくさいのか、なんとなくもじもじして、
落ち着かないでいる。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki was obviously embarassed and nervous. She couldn't
stop fidgeting.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki was obviously embarassed and nervous. She couldn't
stop fidgeting.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「本当にありがとう」
dialogues.en: "I'm really grateful."
dialogues.text: "I'm really grateful."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そんな、いいですよ。気にしないで下さい」
dialogues.en: "I, it's fine. Don't worry about it."
dialogues.text: "I, it's fine. Don't worry about it."

dialogues.jp: 環は慌てて、ことりに言う。
dialogues.en: She reassured Kotori, stumbling over her words slightly.
dialogues.text: She reassured Kotori, stumbling over her words slightly.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「これから大変でしょうけど、頑張ってね」
dialogues.en: "I know this must be troubling for you, but do your best!"
dialogues.text: "I know this must be troubling for you, but do your best!"

dialogues.jp: え？　これから大変って何が？
dialogues.en: Eh? What must be troubling?
dialogues.text: Eh? What must be troubling?

dialogues.jp: ことりの意味深な発言が気になる。
dialogues.en: Kotori seemed to be hiding something in her words.
dialogues.text: Kotori seemed to be hiding something in her words.

dialogues.jp: 俺が聞こうとしたとき、
dialogues.en: Before I could ask what she meant, though,
dialogues.text: Before I could ask what she meant, though,

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、また」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, I'd see you two later!"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, I'd see you two later!"

dialogues.jp:
ことりは、早々と教室の方へと入っていってし
まう。
dialogues.en: Kotori quickly left for the shelter of the classroom.
dialogues.text: Kotori quickly left for the shelter of the classroom.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、びっくりした」
dialogues.en: "Ahh... that was quite a fright."
dialogues.text: "Ahh... that was quite a fright."

dialogues.jp: 環は胸に手を当てて、ほっとしている。
dialogues.en: Tamaki brought her hand to her chest, sighing heavily.
dialogues.text: Tamaki brought her hand to her chest, sighing heavily.

dialogues.jp: 「どうして？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? How so?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? How so?"

dialogues.speaker: Tsamaki
dialogues.jp:
「白河さんって、本当に可愛くて、女のわたく
　しでもドキドキしてしまいます」
dialogues.en:
"Shirakawa-san is so cute, she even makes a girl's heart,
like my own, beat faster..."
dialogues.text:
"Shirakawa-san is so cute, she even makes a girl's heart,
like my own, beat faster..."

dialogues.jp:
ことりの意味深な発言には何も感じてないらし
い。
dialogues.en: Looks like Kotori's implications flew over her head.
dialogues.text: Looks like Kotori's implications flew over her head.

dialogues.jp: 俺、深読みしすぎなのかな……。
dialogues.en: Or maybe I was just reading too much into it.
dialogues.text: Or maybe I was just reading too much into it.

dialogues.jp: それよりも……。
dialogues.en: More importantly...
dialogues.text: More importantly...

dialogues.jp: 「何、言ってんだよ。環だって……」
dialogues.en: "What are you saying? You're just..."
dialogues.text: "What are you saying? You're just..."

dialogues.jp:
環だって、充分可愛いじゃないか、という言葉
を、照れくさくて思わず飲み込む。
dialogues.en:
You're just as cute... was what I wanted to say, but the
sheer embarassment of it made me gulp the words down.
dialogues.text:
You're just as cute... was what I wanted to say, but the
sheer embarassment of it made me gulp the words down.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「それに……」

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「それに？」
dialogues.en: "And?"
dialogues.text: "And?"

dialogues.jp: まだ何かあるのか？
dialogues.en: Did something happen again?
dialogues.text: Did something happen again?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「今まで予知能力を使って、お礼を言われたこ
　となんてないんですもの」
dialogues.en:
"My powers did not tell me anything about Shirakawa-san
thanking me."
dialogues.text:
"My powers did not tell me anything about Shirakawa-san
thanking me."

dialogues.jp: あ、そうか。
dialogues.en: Ah, that.
dialogues.text: Ah, that.

dialogues.jp:
今まで、責められることはあっても、認められ
ることは少なかったんだな。
dialogues.en:
Even now, she wouldn't let what could've happened to Kotori,
happen.
dialogues.text:
Even now, she wouldn't let what could've happened to Kotori,
happen.

dialogues.jp:
いつも、誰かのためにと思っても、それが裏目
に出てしまうことが多かった……。
dialogues.en:
She's always thinking so much about others, that she forgets
how much it could backfire on herself...
dialogues.text:
She's always thinking so much about others, that she forgets
how much it could backfire on herself...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「感謝されるって、嬉しいですね」
dialogues.en: "She was so grateful, it made me happy."
dialogues.text: "She was so grateful, it made me happy."

dialogues.jp: 環は笑顔で言う。
dialogues.en: The smile on her face told it all.
dialogues.text: The smile on her face told it all.

dialogues.jp: やっと、報われた時が来たんだな。
dialogues.en: Finally, she had a reason to be happy about her powers.
dialogues.text: Finally, she had a reason to be happy about her powers.

dialogues.jp: 何だか、俺も嬉しい。
dialogues.en: It made me glad too.
dialogues.text: It made me glad too.

dialogues.jp: そう言ってやろうと思ったとき、
dialogues.en: However, Just in time to destroy the joyful moment,
dialogues.text: However, Just in time to destroy the joyful moment,

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「よ、ご両人」
dialogues.en: "Hello, you two."
dialogues.text: "Hello, you two."

dialogues.jp: 絶妙のタイミングで邪魔をするやつがいる。
dialogues.en:
The proverbial "third person" in the "crowd" showed up with
impeccable timing.
dialogues.text:
The proverbial "third person" in the "crowd" showed up with
impeccable timing.

dialogues.jp: 「よう」
dialogues.en: "Hi."
dialogues.text: "Hi."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉、また同じクラスだな」
dialogues.en: "Asakura, we're in the same class yet again."
dialogues.text: "Asakura, we're in the same class yet again."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「腐れ縁みたいだな」
dialogues.en:
"The chains that bind us appear to be far too tight,
unfortunately."
dialogues.text:
"The chains that bind us appear to be far too tight,
unfortunately."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「胡ノ宮嬢は、確か１組だったと記憶している
　が……」
dialogues.en: "If I recall correctly, Konomiya was in Class 1..."
dialogues.text: "If I recall correctly, Konomiya was in Class 1..."

dialogues.jp: 何でちゃっかりチェックしてるんだよ。
dialogues.en: Why was he looking for her name?
dialogues.text: Why was he looking for her name?

dialogues.jp: 環は意外にも、残念そうに、
dialogues.en: Unexpectedly, Tamaki spoke up with regret,
dialogues.text: Unexpectedly, Tamaki spoke up with regret,

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「杉並様とも離れてしまって残念です」
dialogues.en:
"It's unfortunate that we're in different classes,
Suginami-sama."
dialogues.text:
"It's unfortunate that we're in different classes,
Suginami-sama."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉もこのくらい殊勝なことを言えるように
　なればな……」
dialogues.en:
"Such caring words should be used not on myself, but on
Asakura..."
dialogues.text:
"Such caring words should be used not on myself, but on
Asakura..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「誰が言うか！」
dialogues.en: "Who said you could speak for me!?"
dialogues.text: "Who said you could speak for me!?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「素直になれ、同志よ。一緒に教室へと参ろう
　ぞ」
dialogues.en: "Honesty is a virtue, my friend. Let us head into class."
dialogues.text: "Honesty is a virtue, my friend. Let us head into class."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「胡ノ宮嬢も、我が学び舎へぜひ来たまえ」
dialogues.en: "Konomiya as well. The school awaits us!"
dialogues.text: "Konomiya as well. The school awaits us!"

dialogues.jp:
と、杉並は俺と環の手をひっぱり、校舎へと入
る。
dialogues.en: Grabbing both of our hands, he dragged us into the building.
dialogues.text: Grabbing both of our hands, he dragged us into the building.

dialogues.jp: ん？　何かまだ、視線を感じるような……。
dialogues.en: Mm? I can feel eyes on me...
dialogues.text: Mm? I can feel eyes on me...

dialogues.jp: 俺は何となく気になって、後ろを振り返る。
dialogues.en: Suspicious, I turned my head around.
dialogues.text: Suspicious, I turned my head around.

dialogues.jp: すると、何人かの生徒がまだこちらを見ている。
dialogues.en: Several students had been staring at us from behind.
dialogues.text: Several students had been staring at us from behind.

dialogues.jp:
俺がそいつらを見つめていると、慌てて目を反
らした。
dialogues.en: They quickly looked away when I returned the stare at them.
dialogues.text: They quickly looked away when I returned the stare at them.

dialogues.jp: 一体、何なんだ……？
dialogues.en: What're they thinking of...?
dialogues.text: What're they thinking of...?

dialogues.jp: 杉並はお構いなしにずんずんと歩いていく。
dialogues.en:
Despite that, Suginami continued on his merry way, dragging
us along with him.
dialogues.text:
Despite that, Suginami continued on his merry way, dragging
us along with him.

dialogues.jp:
教室まで来ると、｛さすが／流石｝に環は入るわけには行か
ないようで、入り口で立ち止まってしまう。
dialogues.en:
We eventually reached my classroom. Tamaki, of course,
hesitated to enter.
dialogues.text:
We eventually reached my classroom. Tamaki, of course,
hesitated to enter.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「じゃ、俺は先に席に着くとするか。二人はそ
　のまま、構わず蜜月を過ごしてくれたまえ」
dialogues.en:
"I shall head on to my desk first. Feel free to continue
wtih your honeymoon."
dialogues.text:
"I shall head on to my desk first. Feel free to continue
wtih your honeymoon."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「み、蜜月？」
dialogues.en: "H, honeymoon?"
dialogues.text: "H, honeymoon?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は真っ赤になり、思わず聞きかえす。
dialogues.en: Hearing those words made me turn red quickly.
dialogues.text: Hearing those words made me turn red quickly.

dialogues.jp: 環を見ると、環も赤面し、俯いている。
dialogues.en: A quick glance at Tamaki showed a similar reaction from her.
dialogues.text: A quick glance at Tamaki showed a similar reaction from her.

dialogues.en: "Ah, um..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, um..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は頭をかきながら、何か会話がないかと探す。
dialogues.en: I cracked my head, trying to think of something to say.
dialogues.text: I cracked my head, trying to think of something to say.

dialogues.jp: このまま別れるのもな……。
dialogues.en: We'd have to seperate here, huh...
dialogues.text: We'd have to seperate here, huh...

dialogues.jp: よし、ここは男らしく……。
dialogues.en: Alright, I have to be a man...
dialogues.text: Alright, I have to be a man...

dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、じゃあ、帰り一緒に帰ろうぜ」
dialogues.en: "W, well, let's walk home together, l, later?"
dialogues.text: "W, well, let's walk home together, l, later?"

dialogues.jp: 俺の言葉に、環は赤面したまま顔を上げる。
dialogues.en: The redness in her face grew even stronger.
dialogues.text: The redness in her face grew even stronger.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「は、はい。じゃ、授業後、教室まで迎えに行
　きますね」
dialogues.en: "Y, yes! I will come to your class after lessons are over."
dialogues.text: "Y, yes! I will come to your class after lessons are over."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「おう」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp: 明らかにぎこちない二人がいる。
dialogues.en:
The awkwardness in the air was thick enough to cut with a
knife.
dialogues.text:
The awkwardness in the air was thick enough to cut with a
knife.

dialogues.jp: 何だか、妙に意識し過ぎてしまっている。
dialogues.en: Even stranger than it usually is.
dialogues.text: Even stranger than it usually is.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「で、では、わたくしは行きますね」
dialogues.en: "I, I'll head to my own class now..."
dialogues.text: "I, I'll head to my own class now..."

dialogues.jp:
環は軽く俺に手を振って、教室の方に歩いてい
く。
dialogues.en: Giving me a small wave, she walked off.
dialogues.text: Giving me a small wave, she walked off.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、環は自分の教室へと入っていくまで見送っ
ている。
dialogues.en:
I watched her back all the way, as she disappeared into one
of the other classrooms.
dialogues.text:
I watched her back all the way, as she disappeared into one
of the other classrooms.

dialogues.jp: 「さてっと……」
dialogues.en: "Now then..."
dialogues.text: "Now then..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は自分の席に着こうと、歩いていく。
dialogues.en:
I took a good look around the class proper. Time to grab a
good seat...
dialogues.text:
I took a good look around the class proper. Time to grab a
good seat...

dialogues.jp: ん？
dialogues.en: Hm?
dialogues.text: Hm?

dialogues.jp: 何か、注目されているような……。
dialogues.en: I still feel like someone's watching me...
dialogues.text: I still feel like someone's watching me...

dialogues.jp: ふと見ると、クラスメートの視線とぶつかる。
dialogues.en:
A quick look all around me revealed that nearly every one of
my classmates had their eyes fixated on me.
dialogues.text:
A quick look all around me revealed that nearly every one of
my classmates had their eyes fixated on me.

dialogues.jp: まただ。
dialogues.en: Not again...
dialogues.text: Not again...

dialogues.jp: 今までのも気のせいじゃなかったのか……？
dialogues.en: All these incidents can't just be my imagination, can it...?
dialogues.text: All these incidents can't just be my imagination, can it...?

dialogues.jp: 俺、何かしたか？
dialogues.en: What DID I do?
dialogues.text: What DID I do?

dialogues.jp:
少なくとも、新聞に載ったり、テレビに出た記
憶はない。
dialogues.en: I haven't appeared in the newspapers or on TV or anything...
dialogues.text: I haven't appeared in the newspapers or on TV or anything...

dialogues.jp: 「なあ、杉並。俺、何か注目されてないか？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Suginami... is there something weird going on today?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Suginami... is there something weird going on today?"

dialogues.jp: 杉並の席に近づき、腑に落ちないまま尋ねる。
dialogues.en: Completely in the dark, I approached Suginami.
dialogues.text: Completely in the dark, I approached Suginami.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ふふ、やっと気づいたか」
dialogues.en: "Oho, you finally noticed."
dialogues.text: "Oho, you finally noticed."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「は？　何が？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? Noticed what?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? Noticed what?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「この教室は、地球外生命体に、のっとられた
　のだ」
dialogues.en: "That an alien life form is present."
dialogues.text: "That an alien life form is present."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Haaah?"
dialogues.text: "Haaah?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「だから、お前だけよそ者ってことだ」
dialogues.en: "Someone that you know very well."
dialogues.text: "Someone that you know very well."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前、今度は何を読んだんだ」
dialogues.en: "...What have you been reading now?"
dialogues.text: "...What have you been reading now?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ＳＦ恋愛小説」
dialogues.en: 'A Sci-Fi Romance novel."
dialogues.text: 'A Sci-Fi Romance novel."

dialogues.jp:
こいつに聞いたのが、やっぱり間違いだった気
がする。
dialogues.en: This wasn't the best of ideas.
dialogues.text: This wasn't the best of ideas.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ま、それは冗談として」
dialogues.en: "Well, that's just a little joke."
dialogues.text: "Well, that's just a little joke."

dialogues.jp: 急に杉並がまじめモードになる。
dialogues.en:
Completely unpredictably, Suginami switched to his serious
mode.
dialogues.text:
Completely unpredictably, Suginami switched to his serious
mode.

dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「お前を見てたんじゃなくて、見られてたのは
　胡ノ宮嬢だ」
dialogues.en:
"They aren't really looking at you, they're thinking about
Konomiya."
dialogues.text:
"They aren't really looking at you, they're thinking about
Konomiya."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「え？　環？　またどうして」
dialogues.en: "What? Tamaki? Why her?"
dialogues.text: "What? Tamaki? Why her?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「わからんのか。鈍いヤツだな」
dialogues.en: "You still don't know? You're really slow."
dialogues.text: "You still don't know? You're really slow."

dialogues.jp: 杉並は含みのある話し方をする。
dialogues.en: The disbelief in his tone was grating.
dialogues.text: The disbelief in his tone was grating.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「この前の卒業パーティーの一件が、知られて
　ないとでも思ってるのか」
dialogues.en:
"Did you think we'd all just forget what happened at the
graduation party?"
dialogues.text:
"Did you think we'd all just forget what happened at the
graduation party?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Oh!"
dialogues.text: "Oh!"

dialogues.jp: そうか。そういえばそこで……。
dialogues.en: That's right... that happened...
dialogues.text: That's right... that happened...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「あれだけ大々的に宣伝すれば、みんな胡ノ宮
　嬢が予知能力者だって気づくだろ」
dialogues.en:
"Considering the publicity it got, it's no surprise that
everyone knows that Konomiya's a prophet."
dialogues.text:
"Considering the publicity it got, it's no surprise that
everyone knows that Konomiya's a prophet."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「本校まで広まるのにあっという間だ」
dialogues.en: "It's even spread to the main school."
dialogues.text: "It's even spread to the main school."

dialogues.jp: 俺は何とも複雑な気持ちに襲われる。
dialogues.en:
All sorts of feelings and emotions attacked me at the same
time.
dialogues.text:
All sorts of feelings and emotions attacked me at the same
time.

dialogues.jp: 仕方がない、と言えば仕方がない。
dialogues.en:
In the end, there's nothing that can be done; I can't change
the past.
dialogues.text:
In the end, there's nothing that can be done; I can't change
the past.

dialogues.jp:
あそこで、環が助けなかったら、ことりは大変
なことになっていただろう。
dialogues.en:
I wouldn't want to even if I could; otherwise, Kotori
would've been injured, after all.
dialogues.text:
I wouldn't want to even if I could; otherwise, Kotori
would've been injured, after all.

dialogues.jp:
俺が環でも、おそらく同じように自分のことを
省みず、助けたと思う。
dialogues.en:
Just like Tamaki had done, I wanted to protect Tamaki's
secret as well.
dialogues.text:
Just like Tamaki had done, I wanted to protect Tamaki's
secret as well.

dialogues.jp: それは、理屈ではない。
dialogues.en: Well, that wasn't the only reason.
dialogues.text: Well, that wasn't the only reason.

dialogues.jp: ただ、助けたいという想いだ。
dialogues.en: But I thought I had saved her, protected her.
dialogues.text: But I thought I had saved her, protected her.

dialogues.jp: だけど……。
dialogues.en: Yet...
dialogues.text: Yet...

dialogues.jp: どうして、いつもこうなってしまうんだ。
dialogues.en: These kind of things keep happening and happening.
dialogues.text: These kind of things keep happening and happening.

dialogues.jp: いつも環は、予知能力で見られてしまう。
dialogues.en: Tamaki's abilities keep getting shown for what they are.
dialogues.text: Tamaki's abilities keep getting shown for what they are.

dialogues.jp: 本当の環は、普通の女の子なのに……。
dialogues.en: Tamaki's really just a normal girl at heart...
dialogues.text: Tamaki's really just a normal girl at heart...

dialogues.jp:
人間の好奇心を、止めることはできないのかも
しれないが、
dialogues.en:
It's never going to be possible to stop people from
wondering, yet...
dialogues.text:
It's never going to be possible to stop people from
wondering, yet...

dialogues.jp:
時にそれが、相手を傷つけることだってあるの
だ。
dialogues.en:
The more this goes on, the more likely that Tamaki will get
hurt by all this.
dialogues.text:
The more this goes on, the more likely that Tamaki will get
hurt by all this.

dialogues.jp:
でも人々は、そんな原始的な無神経さには気づ
かない。
dialogues.en:
People, at their core, just want what they want; their own
insensitivity flying completely over their own heads.
dialogues.text:
People, at their core, just want what they want; their own
insensitivity flying completely over their own heads.

dialogues.jp: なぜなら相手は興味の対象でしかないから……。
dialogues.en:
I don't want people to be an irritance to Tamaki like
that...
dialogues.text:
I don't want people to be an irritance to Tamaki like
that...

dialogues.jp:
この、教室にいるクラスメートも、環のことは、
興味の対象でしかない。
dialogues.en: Especially not the people in my own class.
dialogues.text: Especially not the people in my own class.

dialogues.jp:
けれど、それは仕方がない。そういう連中を責
めることはできない。
dialogues.en:
But there's nothing I can do... I can't really blame them
for being curious either.
dialogues.text:
But there's nothing I can do... I can't really blame them
for being curious either.

dialogues.jp:
だから──、だから、俺だけは、あいつのこと、
ちゃんと見てやらなきゃ。
dialogues.en: That's why──that's why, I couldn't face her later.
dialogues.text: That's why──that's why, I couldn't face her later.

dialogues.jp: あらためてそう思うのだった。
dialogues.en: I thought I could change things, but in the end...
dialogues.text: I thought I could change things, but in the end...

dialogues.jp: 学校が終わると、俺と環は一緒に神社まで帰る。
dialogues.en: And with the other hand, to her chest,
dialogues.text: And with the other hand, to her chest,

dialogues.jp: しかし、俺は環の顔をまともに見れない。
dialogues.en: The place where no one should touch,
dialogues.text: The place where no one should touch,

dialogues.jp: 何を話していいのかわからない。
dialogues.en: With a sudden burst of power, Tamaki pushed me away.
dialogues.text: With a sudden burst of power, Tamaki pushed me away.

dialogues.jp: 朝、杉並の言った言葉が気にかかる。
dialogues.en:
She was flustered for a few seconds, but eventually regained
her bearings.
dialogues.text:
She was flustered for a few seconds, but eventually regained
her bearings.

dialogues.jp:
予知能力が学校中に知れ渡ってしまったこと
……。
dialogues.en: She then looked at me with a worried face.
dialogues.text: She then looked at me with a worried face.

dialogues.jp:
環に話すべきなのか、それとも黙っているべき
なのか……。
dialogues.en: --What on earth am I doing?
dialogues.text: --What on earth am I doing?

dialogues.jp: 自分でも判断がつかない。
dialogues.en:
"Tamaki... I'm sorry. I... really didn't mean to. I can't
apologize enough."
dialogues.text:
"Tamaki... I'm sorry. I... really didn't mean to. I can't
apologize enough."

dialogues.jp: 正直、どちらが環のためいいのかわからない。
dialogues.en: Are we really dating? Do we really love each other?
dialogues.text: Are we really dating? Do we really love each other?

dialogues.en:
Those questions were running through my head, and I did
something horrible in order to try to answer them.
dialogues.text:
Those questions were running through my head, and I did
something horrible in order to try to answer them.

dialogues.jp: さて、弱った……。
dialogues.en: "Tamaki, I'm really sorry, I'll..."
dialogues.text: "Tamaki, I'm really sorry, I'll..."

dialogues.jp: 俺が悩んでいると、
dialogues.en: Tamaki straightened her dress a bit, then walked up to me.
dialogues.text: Tamaki straightened her dress a bit, then walked up to me.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様？」
dialogues.en: "I also... really..."
dialogues.text: "I also... really..."

dialogues.jp: 不思議そうな顔で、環が尋ねてくる。
dialogues.en: She sat down next to me. She'd always been there for me.
dialogues.text: She sat down next to me. She'd always been there for me.

dialogues.en: With damp eyes, she continued speaking,
dialogues.text: With damp eyes, she continued speaking,

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「どうかしたんですか？」
dialogues.en: "I also want to.. .with Asakura-sama..."
dialogues.text: "I also want to.. .with Asakura-sama..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いや、別に……」
dialogues.en: "Please... hold me..."
dialogues.text: "Please... hold me..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、つい言いそびれてしまう。
dialogues.en: "T, T, Tamaki..."
dialogues.text: "T, T, Tamaki..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか」
dialogues.en:
"I also want to be linked to Asakura-sama. A link as proof
of our love."
dialogues.text:
"I also want to be linked to Asakura-sama. A link as proof
of our love."

dialogues.jp: 環に、いつもと変わった様子はない。
dialogues.en: "Are you sure, Tamaki?"
dialogues.text: "Are you sure, Tamaki?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki

dialogues.en:
Suginami informed me that the clairvoyance that Tamaki had
shown during the graduation party was now common knowledge.
dialogues.text:
Suginami informed me that the clairvoyance that Tamaki had
shown during the graduation party was now common knowledge.

dialogues.jp:
卒業パーティーで、予知能力が大々的に知られ
てしまったからだと、杉並が教えてくれた。
dialogues.en: So in the end, we were found out.
dialogues.text: So in the end, we were found out.

dialogues.jp: 結局、そうなってしまうのか。
dialogues.en:
On the way home to her shrine, Tamaki invited me to have tea
with her.
dialogues.text:
On the way home to her shrine, Tamaki invited me to have tea
with her.

dialogues.jp:
帰りに神社によると、環がお茶をご馳走してく
れる。
dialogues.en:
Although we were together, there was still that nagging
feeling inside me, that wanted proof.
dialogues.text:
Although we were together, there was still that nagging
feeling inside me, that wanted proof.

dialogues.jp:
何気なくお守りの仕分けを見ていると、環が縁
結びのお守りをくれた。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki felt the same way I did. We threw off our anxieties,
and for just a moment, became one.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki felt the same way I did. We threw off our anxieties,
and for just a moment, became one.

dialogues.jp: 見ると、環とおそろいらしい。
dialogues.en:
And after that, Tamaki gave me a marriage charm. It suited
us well.
dialogues.text:
And after that, Tamaki gave me a marriage charm. It suited
us well.

dialogues.jp:
昔は、おそろいなんてとバカにしていたが、今
はなんとなくわかる。自分の大切な人と、いつ
もつながっているような気持ち。
dialogues.en:
In days before, I would've thought it was stupid. But now,
it was a link to the person most important to me.
dialogues.text:
In days before, I would've thought it was stupid. But now,
it was a link to the person most important to me.

dialogues.jp: 恥ずかしい気分は、今も昔も変わらないけど。
dialogues.en:
Although the embarassment part from old times hadn't
changed.
dialogues.text:
Although the embarassment part from old times hadn't
changed.
